name: set-union
description: Grow-only set union combining elements from concurrent ops. tags declares no value_type, so its elements are not normalized -- which is what lets this vector also pin spec/fold.md §5/§8's UTF-8 byte sort order (ruled over UTF-16 code unit order, spec/fold.md §8): '\ue000' (BMP private use, UTF-8 EE 80 80) and '\ud83d\ude00' (U+1F600, a supplementary-plane character, UTF-8 F0 9F 98 80). UTF-8 byte order places \ue000 before \ud83d\ude00 (0xEE < 0xF0); UTF-16 code unit order would place \ud83d\ude00 first, because its surrogate pair's lead unit D83D sorts below E000 -- see spec/canonicalization.md's 'supplementary-plane vs BMP' vector, which governs JSON object member keys under that opposite order on purpose. expected_state below is the UTF-8 ordering only; a UTF-16 implementation fails here loudly rather than silently.
